segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: You have to leave the red button down, Elena. Otherwise nobody can hear the important announcements.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: The important announcement is that Iris has stolen my chair.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: It was an emergency broadcast.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Then announce that the potatoes are ready. And stop both of you making that face at me.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: Nobody can hear a face.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I can.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Leave the light on.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I am not angry with you.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Stop the recorder for a minute.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: Elena is here. I said no tablets. I need to be awake tomorrow. She says it is plain, so I am having that and then we are going to attempt being grown-ups.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: M, are you awake? I am very dizzy. E, please wait. I do not want to lie down yet.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: She is exhausted. I am with her. Do not come over and make it a whole thing.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: If you cannot wake her properly, call for help now. I mean it. Please tell me you have.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I am calling them now. I will stay.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: It is me. You said to come over.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: I know. I am opening it. Please bring the other chair in if it is still out there.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Leave the light on. Your sister is still looking for the red button.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: It is under the chair. Iris put it there.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I am not angry with you. I am trying to get the potatoes out before they turn to glue.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: Later source span, after a declared gap.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Do not tell me I never listened. That is not fair. Stop the recorder for a minute.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: A further source gap is declared here.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I am sorry I said that. You do not have to take care of my feelings every time I get tired.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I have put the agreement, the keys and the list of people in separate envelopes. I know that is not what happened to her. It is what I can do this morning. The solicitor said you were already named, so I signed. I would like there to be one thing we did the way she asked. Do you need me to move the cup?

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: She would send a photograph of something broken and ask whether it was meant to look like that. Usually it was a joke. Sometimes it was not. I fixed the blue mug three times. She kept saying it was staying because I had fixed it. I thought that was sweet. Then I would get cross because she would not let me give her something better. We could turn almost anything into both kinds of conversation.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I want people to hear it properly. I want the room to open, or to close for a reason someone can put in a sentence. At the moment everybody is being very gentle and carrying on with whatever they had already decided. Iris hated that. So do I, when it happens to me.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: It began with a Sunday afternoon and the radio button under a chair. She could hear our faces. That was what I wanted back. I know there were other afternoons. You do not have to tell me that before I am allowed to miss this one.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: That rider was not meant to be a test of whether I loved her correctly. I signed because she asked for somewhere we could disagree. I thought someone outside the studio might finally say we were allowed to keep the good part. I did not think the first thing you would ask was who got to decide what good meant.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: She could say a perfectly reasonable thing in the exact voice that made me feel twelve. Then I would hear myself answering in the voice I had promised never to use. I am not telling you that because it explains what happened. I am telling you because if you put one sentence from those arguments in your report, you can make either of us the person you need.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I know which pages you have now. Please do not lay them out as though I am about to discover them with you. You can ask me something. I may not give you the answer you want. But stop making that quiet voice people use when they have already decided what someone can bear.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I was there. I brought the container. Those are not things I am asking you to pretend otherwise about. She would not stop talking about the morning. About stopping the release, about finding the right language. I wanted one evening when a decision did not belong to the person who could explain it best. That does not tell you everything I did. It tells you why I was still in the room.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I told Mara I was calling. I knew she would believe me if I made it sound like a practical thing I was already doing. I did not want her there asking the questions I could not answer. Do not turn that into a sentence about being confused. I was frightened. I still understood what would happen when somebody else came into the room.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I saw the words on the fold. I knew there was a difference between something for the project and something for me. I kept telling myself that she would change her mind when the right person asked. After a while that stopped being something I thought about Iris and became a way not to think about myself.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: I can tell you what I remember about us. I cannot make that record say something else because you have put it in front of me.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: I was going to make coffee and then realised I would ask how she took it. I have known her for sixteen years. There are apparently still ways for the morning to surprise you. You have the delivery. I can sit here while you open it, if that is easier. I cannot promise not to talk over the embarrassing bits.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: We had a café where the chairs were so uncomfortable nobody could stay long enough to make work into the whole afternoon. She once ordered the largest sandwich I have ever seen and then told me I was not allowed to discuss structural integrity. I have no useful inference to attach to that. I just keep remembering the way she tried not to laugh with a mouth full of bread.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: I edit sound. You would think that meant I was good at hearing the thing somebody actually said. Mostly it means I am good at hearing the thing they wish they had said with a little less room noise. I know. That sounds like a warning when you say it today. It used to sound like work.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: The delivery account is mine. MOTH is a studio tool, not a person hiding in your phone. Iris left the instruction and the review needed a package. I sent what people had been hearing. The parts of the working index I left out make my choices much easier to see. I wanted to explain before I had to defend myself. That is not the same as giving you the whole copy.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: She told me she had approved it too. I thought she was letting me off, which shows how carefully I was listening. She was asking for both names to stay on the record. I was busy thinking about whose work would look worse.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: I made a listening copy for Elena. Then I let restored become original. Nobody made me type the second word. When Iris stopped defending it I thought she had abandoned the work we had made together. I did not ask whether she was trying to come back to it honestly. Julia has the retained copy even if I refuse. I am not going to make you go round the room for it.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: I heard someone who was dizzy and then an adult who said she was with her. I told Elena to get help if Iris could not be woken properly. She said she was calling. I believed that because it was the thing I needed an adult in the room to do. I was not in the room. I did not hear a dispatcher. Keep that distinction, even if it makes my part smaller than I would like.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: I have given you the source and the messages. You do not need to like me for them to remain originals. It is strange how much of my life I have spent saying some version of trust me, and how little comfort there is in discovering that people should have asked for something else.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: My name on the edit. The source dates. The fact that Iris agreed to things and later withdrew that agreement. Do not improve either of us. The first bad label was meant to make something easier to hear. I do not think I get to use that reason again.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: The sandwiches were real. The stupid things we said before a photograph were real. I do not want to offer them as evidence that I could not hurt her. I want there to be some part of being her friend that does not have to stand in court and defend the rest of me.

segments.speaker: Mara
segments.text: I do not know a useful answer to that record. Ask me about my own work. It will be less comfortable and more accurate.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: I said she was exhausted. I knew that was true, and I thought a true thing could not do any harm. Since then I have watched people put it beside things it does not explain. I still do not want to make the private conversation public. You may have to tell me which question you can ask without making that the price of answering.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: I made dinner too late. She pretended to object and ate it standing up while she told me something about a sound I would not have noticed. I wanted the story to finish so we could sit down. Then, if she stopped telling it, I asked what happened next. I have been remembering that as though it is an argument I can still correct.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: We were trying to find a decent way to stop being together. I gave you a picture of someone too tired to know what she wanted. It let me leave out the part where she knew very well. I can give you the exchange with her permission already in it for the project record. I would like it not to become a poster about how people grieve.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: I offered. She ordered her own car. I was hurt in the very ordinary, unhelpful way of somebody discovering that they are not required. I did not go to the apartment. Do not use a receipt with my name on it from another week to put me somewhere, or to take me out of somewhere. Ask for the actual appointment record.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: She asked me to get boxes the next day. That was her plan. Not ours, and not a symptom. She was trying to do two painful things at once without making one the reason she did not have to do the other. I kept calling it a bad week. It was easier than calling it her decision.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: You have the conversation now. I am not going to ask whether it made me look better. I have been asking that question in one form or another since you arrived. I can answer about what I saw. About the rest, I should have learned to say I do not know before it mattered.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: Keep that she was leaving me. Keep that I offered the boxes. Those can both stay true. Please do not call the second one proof that I was good about the first.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: I want to say I should not have described her for them. I do not know whether they will hear that as an apology or another thing I am trying to get right in public. I may have to say it without knowing.

segments.speaker: Adrian
segments.text: I cannot answer that from something I actually saw. I have already made enough of an account out of how I felt.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: There are staff waiting to know whether they have work next month. That is not a threat. It is one of the facts everybody finds distasteful when I mention it. Iris signed the original use schedule. I signed the review rider. I have not cancelled either piece of paper. Ask me about what the studio approved.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: Because stopping is a decision too. Equipment goes back, people do not get paid, a room that took a year to build becomes a room with cables in it. I am aware that none of that makes a label true. I would like you to be aware that it was not only a label to the people who built the room.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: She said she did not want the public schedule to promise agreement that did not exist. I said the agreement was signed. She said she was one of the people whose agreement it described, and I could begin by listening to her change her mind. I thought it was an impossible way to run a company. I can hear how that sounds now. I said it anyway.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: There were two pieces of work. A family listening edit and a public assembly. They did not have the same approval route. The provider copies will say that. I should have made the second permission explicit before using the first material. I cannot turn that into a bookkeeping oversight just because I have brought a spreadsheet.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: I saw that message in the morning. I had wanted the discussion delayed. That does not mean I knew how Elena proposed to delay it. You should preserve the sentence and the time, including the time of my reply. If you find evidence of a different arrangement, ask me about it. Do not fill one in because it would make the financial story tidier.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: The current public schedule is suspended. The independent copy has been retained. I am trying very hard not to tell you that I have done what I was asked, as though that settles the decisions that made asking necessary.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: Some of it can exist with honest labels. Some of it depended on an audience misunderstanding what it heard. That distinction is going to cost us. I do not get to describe the cost as somebody else destroying the work.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: I approved a use before its permission was settled. I pressed Iris to treat a principled objection as a scheduling problem. I wanted the comfort of a signed form without the inconvenience of a person still speaking. Put those in the report in plain language.

segments.speaker: Victor
segments.text: I can answer for an approval I made. I cannot authenticate a private exchange merely because it is now in the studio folder.

segments.speaker: Luca
segments.text: The case has two wheels. I keep saying that because people keep talking about a second set of feet in the receiving photograph. I can explain what I transported and what I repaired. I am not going to explain Iris by telling you how she used to be with me.

segments.speaker: Luca
segments.text: I had permission for the break. I did not have permission to tell Victor where the box was going. I let the first fact stand in for the second when I was asked about the night. Julia signed for the case. You can check her record without trusting my account of why I was keeping quiet.

segments.speaker: Luca
segments.text: I kept calling after Iris asked me to stop. Then I told myself that the work was too important to wait for somebody to answer me. She told me to send the repair record to Julia. It was a very clear instruction. I followed it eventually. I would prefer you did not turn eventually into proof that I was secretly the person who understood her best.

segments.speaker: Luca
segments.text: A reel can run at the wrong speed. A splice can remove the scrape before a sentence. Those are things I can demonstrate. I cannot put back what somebody meant by saying it. We used audible slate words because the paper labels kept coming off. It is an index, not an initiation test. The alphabet is on the sheet.

segments.speaker: Luca
segments.text: You have the recipient copy and the source alignment now. You do not need me to keep repeating the technical explanation. If you want to ask why I thought keeping a secret for her was different from doing what she asked, that is a less comfortable question. I have not finished answering it to myself.

segments.speaker: Luca
segments.text: It made it possible for somebody outside the studio to say no to us. That was the point. I thought I was doing a favour for Iris. She was arranging something that would not need any of us to keep being generous.

segments.speaker: Luca
segments.text: The source, the labels, the little paper sleeves even if somebody thinks they are rubbish. Give people their ordinary things back before you decide which ones are important enough to keep.

segments.speaker: Luca
segments.text: I cannot get that from a mark on a floor or a sound on a tape. If I start saying I can, ask me to show you exactly where.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: I have put the original receipt on top. You may inspect the seal without opening the inner envelope. If you ask me whether Iris looked sad at the appointment, I will have to give you a very unreliable answer. If you ask me what she instructed me to return, I can show you where she wrote it.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: She wanted a second chair left in the room. Nobody used it. I noticed because I had to move it to get the case past the table. That is the kind of thing people make into a symbol afterwards. At the time it was a chair in the way of the work. She checked the routing, signed the receipt and took the envelope.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: Because somebody may change a description, or die, or lose the drawer key. It is not a vote of no confidence in one particular person. Iris asked for an independent copy. If Mara declines to supply hers, I can supply the documented reference within the same scope. You do not have to make a person feel sufficiently guilty to get the original.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: A complete evidential account is not the same thing as a public copy of every private thing. I can certify the relevant words and source positions without asking the family to perform the whole afternoon for you. If you decide not to hear it, the facts do not become less available. You simply have not heard it.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: She was careful about the addressees. One instruction to the project, one envelope for Elena. I asked if I could put them together. She said that was what she was trying to stop everybody doing. You have the duplicate routing sheet from before the death. The personal letter is not needed to make that instruction true.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: The original evidence has been preserved for the authorised review. Now you need to say which parts of your account are findings, which are inferences, and which belong to somebody who has not offered them to the public. Those distinctions will not make the ending painless. They will make it more honest.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: Yes. State the account, preserve the sources and make the referral. An acknowledgment may matter to the people involved. It is not a condition you can impose on the truth. Do not put yourself or anyone else through a meeting merely because a story usually ends in one.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: The labels must be corrected. The raw family material does not have to become an exhibit about the failure of an exhibit. You can make a factual notice, seek consent for context, or place the complete record with an independent custodian while timing is settled. None of those choices permits losing the evidence.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: An exact minute the clinical report cannot supply. What would have happened under a different intervention. An eventual legal decision. Do not turn those limits into uncertainty about every act the record does support. Equally, do not turn a supported act into permission to invent what you cannot know.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: I can preserve that source or explain its custody. I cannot make its author know something the record does not contain.
